'''2016 EGP Mike Turner LS Echo Base Operations''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Mike Turner]] at [[2016 Endor Grand Prix]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Mike Turner]]
* '''Event:''' [[2016 Endor Grand Prix]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hoth (location)|Hoth-L-hoth.gif|label=Hoth}}
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
* '''Source:''' [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2016-endor-grand-prix/ PC list]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261013130058/https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/2016-endor-grand-prix.html Internet Archive]
